catalog_name: Open-DV Ontology Construction Studio Golden Competency Questions

competency_questions.question: What Funds does an institutional Limited Partner commit capital to?
competency_questions.description: Evaluates capital commitment agreements between institutional investors and private equity fund vehicles.

competency_questions.question: Which Portfolio Companies are managed by a private equity Fund vehicle?
competency_questions.description: Evaluates direct deal target investments and co-investment syndication allocations.

competency_questions.question: What legal agreements or Side Letters are bound to an LP's commitment?
competency_questions.description: Binds unstructured LP Side Letter legal documents to the governed fund and beneficiary limited partner.

competency_questions.question: Which Investment Committee valuation memoranda evaluate a specific Portfolio Company?
competency_questions.description: Links unstructured Investment Committee valuation memoranda to the target operating portfolio company.

competency_questions.question: How are legacy regional LP account keys resolved to canonical LP identities?
competency_questions.description: Resolves Tier-3 BKCC legacy investor account keys to canonical Tier-1/Tier-2 master limited partner identities.

competency_questions.question: What investment strategies are permitted for a Fund vehicle?
competency_questions.description: Validates reference enumeration for fund investment strategies (Buyout, Co-Invest, Growth Equity, Secondaries).

competency_questions.question: Which industry sectors are targeted by a Portfolio Company?
competency_questions.description: Validates reference enumeration for target portfolio company industry sectors.

competency_questions.question: Which regulated depository bank acts as custodian for Fund escrow accounts?
competency_questions.description: Identifies regulated custodian banks holding escrow and wire settlement accounts for funds.

competency_questions.question: What are the confidential PII attributes governing an institutional investor?
competency_questions.description: Ensures governance isolation and satellite segregation for sensitive PII investor attributes.

competency_questions.question: What are the MNPI valuation attributes governing a portfolio asset?
competency_questions.description: Ensures governance isolation and satellite segregation for material non-public valuation metrics.

competency_questions.question: Which customer accounts are associated with a legal party?
competency_questions.description: Maps legal parties to customer entities and their advisory wealth accounts.

competency_questions.question: What portfolios are held under a wealth advisory customer account?
competency_questions.description: Determines investment portfolios managed under an advisory account mandate.

competency_questions.question: What financial instruments are held within an investment portfolio?
competency_questions.description: Identifies position holdings of negotiable financial instruments across investment portfolios.

competency_questions.question: Which party acts as credit guarantor for a customer account?
competency_questions.description: Validates third-party credit guarantee and collateral commitments backing customer accounts.

competency_questions.question: Which depository custodian bank settles portfolio transactions?
competency_questions.description: Determines clearing and depository custodian bank relationships settling portfolio trades.

competency_questions.question: What is the operational lifecycle status of a customer account?
competency_questions.description: Validates customer lifecycle status reference enumeration (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, CLOSED).

competency_questions.question: What is the assigned risk tolerance profile for an investment portfolio?
competency_questions.description: Validates investment portfolio risk tolerance profile enumeration (CONSERVATIVE, MODERATE, AGGRESSIVE).

competency_questions.question: What total financial exposure is calculated across a party's relationships?
competency_questions.description: Computes aggregated credit and balance sheet exposure across all accounts associated with a party.

competency_questions.question: What is the maximum credit limit assigned to a customer entity?
competency_questions.description: Evaluates maximum credit or overdraft ceiling established for a customer entity.

competency_questions.question: Which external FIBO classification grounds the legal party concept?
competency_questions.description: Verifies FIBO reference ontology semantic alignment for the party concept to FIBO LegalEntity.
